text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah. This should be good for 
luggage.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, do you mind if I listen to 
the radio— Whoops! Sorry, were you working 
on something?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, I just finished.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, preparing for the away race... Oh 
right, you're already leaving for Kyoto 
tomorrow, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please stay safe in your debut race. I'll 
be cheering for you from the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ......

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...I heard Lala-san's strong ties are 
with Hanshin, not Kyoto, though...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, they're much more accustomed to 
being over there than I am...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Miss Lala. ...Could you check the 
preparations?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, me? It feels like Believe-san 
wouldn't have any problem with that, 
though—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's my first assignment, after all. I 
wanted to make sure I was fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Still, if it's too much trouble...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, not at all, it's no trouble!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're fine with me. I'll take a 
quick look for ya."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think there's no problem 
whatsoever! If I had to mention something, 
though—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The travel takes about three hours one way 
or another. I wonder if we should bring 
something to pass the time?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Killing time......

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh... B-Believe-san? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. I hadn't thought about it... at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't even realized it was necessary, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh~... Believe-san, staying still 
like that, could it be that you're pretty 
much—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. If it's only for about three 
hours.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“Just in case, I'll look around for 
something. Thank you very much.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Reeeaaally, ya got the patience 
of a saint...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta follow that example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now, the day of the debut race had 
finally arrived—!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'm finished changing.
choice_data_list:
O-okay. Then let's do a little 
streeetching——

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Squeak?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ………… Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Your face is the color of cement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having it pointed out, I instinctively 
covered my face with both hands. I had 
been told before that I wear my emotions 
on my sleeve, but I never imagined it had 
gotten this obvious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, facts are facts. Pathetically 
enough... I was nervous. Deeply, deeply 
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After covering my face, I slap both my 
cheeks with my hands. Desperately psyching 
myself back up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Believe is the one who must now 
step foot onto the highest stage in the 
racing world...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
It's fine! Everything will be fine, 
Believe!

It's fine! Everything will be fine, 
Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (This time it's reddish-brown...)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~~... Fighting spirit, fighting 
spirit, fighting spirit...! It's okay, 
from here on... I can do this, I can do 
this...!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? My shoelace is undone... I gotta 
tie it before leaving the paddock... 
T-Tie... Uuu, please stop shaking, 
hands~~~...!!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Outfit, check. Horseshoes, check. No pain 
anywhere. No discomfort, either.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A-All right. Then let's do some 
stretchies—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“It's okay! You're going to be fine, 
Believe!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“It's okay! You're going to be fine, 
Believe!”

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Cement gray... and iron oxide red—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's okay.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the runners have entered the 
paddock! Which Umamusume will seize a 
glorious victory today...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Alright—time for my first job.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(First, I'll pour everything into this. 
Every bit of technique I possess right 
now.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(And I will observe further. To determine 
the work... that I ought to undertake.)

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's on, it's showing on screen. 
Look, seems like they're about to run now.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: So it begins. ...Finally.
